import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

for p in [1,2,3]:
    di,do=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'],G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    h,w=len(di),len(do[0]); bg=di[0][0]
    objs=comps(di,bg)
    # attribute each bg cell to nearest object by chebyshev distance to bbox center
    def attn(i,j):
        cands=[]
        for idx,c in enumerate(objs):
            rs=[a for a,_ in c];ccs=[b for _,b in c]
            rr=range(min(rs),max(rs)+1); cc=range(min(ccs),max(ccs)+1)
            mr,mc=(min(rr)+max(rr))/2,(min(cc)+max(cc))/2
            dd=max(abs(i-mr),abs(j-mc))
            cands.append((dd,idx))
        return min(cands)[1]
    threes={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if do[i][j]==3}
    ones={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if do[i][j]==1}
    nine={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if do[i][j]==bg}
    for idx in range(len(objs)):
        c=objs[idx]; col=di[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        rs=[a for a,_ in c];ccs=[b for _,b in c]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(ccs),max(ccs)
        mr,mc=(r0+r1)/2,(c0+c1)/2
        nb=sum(1 for (i,j) in nine if abs(int(i)-mr)<=max(r1-r0,c1-c0) and abs(int(j)-mc)<=max(r1-r0,c1-c0))
        print(p,'obj',idx,kk:=None,'col',col,'center',(round(mr,1),round(mc,1)),'nb9_in_bbox_region:',nb,
              'ones_near:',sum(1 for (i,j) in ones if max(abs(int(i)-mr),abs(int(j)-mc))<=max(r1-r0,c1-c0)))

steps.input:
# precise 1-cell tables per demo
for p in [1,2,3,4]:
    d=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'];o=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    h,w=len(o),len(o[0]); bg=d[0][0]
    ones=sorted((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if o[r][c]==1)
    objs=[(min(a for a,b in comp),max(a for a,b in comp),min(b for a,b in comp),max(b for a,b in comp))
         for comp in [{ (i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if d[i][j]!=bg }]]
    # rebuild comps
    import itertools
    cells=set((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if d[i][j]!=bg)
    used=set(); objs=[]
    for x in cells:
        if x in used: continue
        q=[x];used.add(x);comp=set()
        while q:
            a,b=q.pop();comp.add((a,b))
            for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
                y=(a+dx,b+dy)
                if y in cells and y not in used: used.add(y);q.append(y)
        objs.append(comp)
    print('=== demo',p)
    for comp in objs:
        rs=[a for a,_ in comp];cs=[b for _,b in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        mine=sorted((a,b) for (a,b) in comp if True) if False else set()
        sub=[ (a,b) for (a,b) in comp if o[a][b]==1]
        below={k for k in ones if c0<=k[1]<=c1 and k[0]>r1}
        print(f'  obj h={r1-r0+1} w={c1-c0+1}: ones_below_in_span={len(sub)}, all_below_span_1={sub==below}')

# collect rich features per background cell; target = 1
def feat(gi,go):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0]); cc=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cc.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=[sorted(c) for c in comps(gi)]
    F={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if gi[i][j]==bg:
                # nearest object cells (manhattan & chebyshev), directions
                objs=[]
                for c in comps:
                    dman=min(abs(i-a)+abs(j-b) for a,b in c)
                    dc=min(abs(i-a),abs(j-b))
                    objs.append((dman,dc,c))
                objs.sort()
                bestc=objs[0][2]
                dr,rb=min(a-i for a,b in bestc), min(b-j for a,b in bestc)
                db,lc=max(a-i for a,b in bestc), max(j-b for a,b in bestc)
                defn=(min(dr,db),min(rb,l),-max(db,-rb),-max(lc,-rb)) if False else None
                F[(i,j)]=dict(dman=objs[0][0],dc=objs[0][1],bestcol=tuple(sorted(bestc)),
                              dr=dr,rb=rb,db=db,lc=lc,nobj=len(comps),h=h,w=w,target=go[i][j]==1)
    return F

import collections
def solve_search(p, verbose=False):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'];go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    ones={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if go[i][j]==1}
    cs=comps_of(gi)
    best={}
    # for each comp, find offsets where translated comp cells subset of ones and large cover
    allcands=[]
    for idx,cc in enumerate(cs):
        options=[]
        for dr in range(-8,h+1):
            for dc in range(-8,w+1):
                tr=[(a+dr,b+dc) for a,b in cc]
                ok=all(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) in ones for a,b in tr)
                if ok: options.append((len(tr),tr))
        allcands.append(options)
    # greedy assignment via exact cover over ones with per-comp choices
    used=set()
    assign=[]
    unsolved=[]
    for i,cs_ in enumerate(allcands):
        cs_.sort(key=lambda x:-len(x[1]))
        found=None
        for s_,t_ in cs_:
            if t_ & ones-notused and len(t_)>=min(len(ones)/4, len(cs_)):
                pass
        # simple: pick option covering max unused
        def cov(opt): return set(opt[1])&ones-used
        mx=max(cov(o) for o in cs_),key=None,
        mx=marginal=None
        scores=[]
        for opt in cs_:
            sc=len(set(opt[1])&ones-used)
            if sc>0: scores.append((sc,len(opt[1])))
        scores.sort(reverse=True)
        if not scores: continue
        _,tt=scores[0]; used|={opt[1]} for tt
        assign.append(tt)
    print(p,'comps',len(cs),'ones',len(ones),'covered',len(used&ones))
    return cs,assign
